_about: Registry for scripts/check_cli_shape.py. env lists every FX_* environment variable fx reads, with its job and stability (Env vars in .fx/skills/fx-cli-shape/references/rules.md). external_env lists the non-fx variables fx reads by name. not_env lists FX_* string literals that are not environment variables. exceptions maps known shape violations to the reason and the finding that removes them; delete an entry when its finding lands. hand_parsed_flags and hand_parsed_files list the flag comparisons that stay hand-written, by flag and by file, with the reason.

not_env.FX_AI_GATEWAY_API_KEY: Keychain service name for the AI Gateway API key, not an env var
not_env.FX_MCP_OAUTH_CREDENTIALS_V3: Keychain service name for MCP OAuth credentials, not an env var
not_env.FX_OAUTH_SESSION_V1: Keychain service name for the fx OAuth session, not an env var
not_env.FX_PARITY_LOG: Set for the fake shell in a unit test; fx never reads it
not_env.FX_TEST_AI_GATEWAY_API_KEY: Keychain service name used by keychain tests, not an env var

hand_parsed_flags.--help: Detects a help request before any command parser runs.
hand_parsed_flags.--version: Detects a version request before any command parser runs.
hand_parsed_flags.--json: Picks the error format when a command's own parser has rejected its arguments.
hand_parsed_flags.--resume: The fixed resume grammar: --resume takes an optional last or ID operand.
hand_parsed_flags.-r: The fixed resume grammar: short for --resume, with the same optional operand.
hand_parsed_flags.--resume=: The fixed resume grammar: --resume with its operand inline.
hand_parsed_flags.--resume-last: Removed resume spelling, matched only to name its replacement.
hand_parsed_flags.--resume-: Removed --resume-<id> spellings, matched only to name the replacement.
hand_parsed_flags.--upgrade-relaunch: The internal word fx upgrade passes when it restarts fx into the new version.
hand_parsed_flags.--id: Removed fx session resume --id spelling, matched only to name its replacement.
hand_parsed_flags.--golden: Maps a missing-value failure onto fx replay's own error.
hand_parsed_flags.-p: Other agents' one-shot flag. fx doesn't accept it; it is matched only to point to fx ask.
hand_parsed_flags.--print: Long form of -p, matched only to point to fx ask.
hand_parsed_flags.--print=: Inline form of --print, matched only to point to fx ask.
hand_parsed_flags.--no-: Pairs each --x with --no-x at compile time to build the launch usage line from launch_options; no argument is read.

run_options._about: One row per option a run can set, named on every surface: the agent-run flag, the setting, its FX_* variable, the ACP config option, and the libfx option. Names may differ by surface, as ACP's mode does, but each one is written here. check_cli_shape fails when ACP offers a config option or libfx's FxModelOptions declares a field that no row names, or when a row names something that doesn't exist.

flag_names.--resume-: Prefix of the removed --resume-<id> alias, kept so the removed spelling fails with a hint.

setting_keys.statusLine: Older spelling of status_line, still read so existing settings files keep working; fx writes only status_line.

hand_parsed_files.src/builtins/skills.zig: Reads a pasted npx skills add command line, another program's flags.
hand_parsed_files.src/core/shell_command/command_classific: Classifies shell commands the agent runs, another program's flags.
hand_parsed_files.src/core/shell_command/command_effect.zi: Reads the flags of git and other commands the agent runs.
hand_parsed_files.src/core/shell_command/command_lex.zig: Reads the flags of timeout, env, and other wrapper commands the agent runs.
hand_parsed_files.src/core/terminal/shell_resolver.zig: Checks the -i fx passes to the user's shell.
hand_parsed_files.src/core/tooling/command_policy.zig: Reads the flags of git and other commands the agent runs, for permission decisions.
